{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean 'revenue' column
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.replace('$', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check if any such customers exist
if filtered_df.empty:
    raise ValueError('No customers found who are both NEW and reached by PAID SEARCH.')

# Compute the fraction who converted
fraction_converted = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

# Print result
fraction_converted"}
